sql: SELECT batter AS batter, (100.0 * CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN launch_speed >= 95.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(launch_speed), 0)) AS hard_hit_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN launch_speed >= 95.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hh, COUNT(launch_speed) AS m FROM read_parquet('/home/158112/baseball_agent/baseball_agent/data_loader/parquet_archive/mlb_statcast_*.parquet') WHERE (game_type = 'R') AND (description = 'hit_into_play') GROUP BY batter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 300 ORDER BY hard_hit_rate DESC LIMIT 3
